candidate_pool: E4 128-frame input, up to 64 original two-frame units at original positions and fixed resolution
selection: Uniform; max between the two frames; or brief change from both temporal neighbours. One unit per temporal bin.
flexi: Same released-kernel port as earlier. Both scale arms use the same fixed-budget contiguous min-cost groups, lengths 2/4/6. Grouping is adapted to the 32-unit budget and is not official ATS.
semvid: Released pruning code with TimeLens2-4B weights; all candidate units encoded, retained visual tokens checked.
primary: transient32 minus uniform32 and transient32 minus motion32, on OMTG and multi-event holdout separately. Secondary 16-unit replication, SemVID and Flexi; exact visual-token comparisons, cluster bootstrap by source.
screening: Promising if OMTG tF1 gains at least 2 points over uniform with CI lower bound above zero, beats motion in point estimate, and is positive on holdout. Explore mechanisms even when the gate is missed.
